source_paper.title: Transient rapamycin treatment can increase lifespan and healthspan in middle-aged mice

population: middle-aged C57BL/6 mice (20 months at start)
intervention: transient rapamycin (8 mg/kg/day i.p.) for 3 months
canonical_phrase: 3 months of rapamycin extended remaining lifespan by ~60% in middle-aged mice
notes: Demonstrated short-course rapamycin gives durable lifespan benefit. Often cited for the 'transient treatment hypothesis'. BOOTSTRAP SEED — re-validate effect size and methodology before cert-blocking; some sources report this as ~50-60% remaining-lifespan extension.

source_paper.title: Transient rapamycin treatment can increase lifespan and healthspan in middle-aged mice

population: male middle-aged C57BL/6 mice (20 months at start)
intervention: transient rapamycin (8 mg/kg/day i.p.) for 3 months
canonical_phrase: 3 months of rapamycin extended median lifespan by 52% in male middle-aged mice
notes: Append-only companion to the existing Bitto 2016 transient rapamycin fact; source abstract reports 60% female and 52% male median lifespan extension. Re-validate before cert-blocking.

source_paper.title: Rapamycin fed late in life extends lifespan in genetically heterogeneous mice

population: female heterogeneous-stock mice (UM-HET3); 4-site NIA Interventions Testing Program cohort
intervention: encapsulated rapamycin in feed (~14 ppm); started at 600 days of age
canonical_phrase: rapamycin extended median lifespan by 9% in females
notes: Original ITP cohort, female cohort. Companion to harrison_2009/lifespan_male. BOOTSTRAP SEED — re-validate before cert-blocking.

source_paper.title: Rapamycin fed late in life extends lifespan in genetically heterogeneous mice

population: male heterogeneous-stock mice (UM-HET3); 4-site NIA Interventions Testing Program cohort
intervention: encapsulated rapamycin in feed (~14 ppm); started at 600 days of age
canonical_phrase: rapamycin extended median lifespan by 14% in males
notes: Original ITP cohort. Replicated by Miller 2014 (dose-response) and Strong 2020 (encapsulated formulation). Female effect ~9% (separate fact). BOOTSTRAP SEED — re-validate before cert-blocking.

source_paper.title: mTOR inhibition improves immune function in the elderly

intervention: RAD001 (everolimus) 0.5 mg daily, 5 mg weekly, or 20 mg weekly for 6 weeks before vaccination
canonical_phrase: RAD001 improved influenza vaccine response by ~20% in the elderly
notes: First human RCT of mTOR inhibition for immunosenescence. Best-responder dose was 0.5 mg daily / 5 mg weekly. BOOTSTRAP SEED — exact effect size varies by strain and dose arm; re-validate against per-arm reporting before cert-blocking.

source_paper.title: Rapamycin-mediated lifespan increase in mice is dose and sex dependent and metabolically distinct from dietary restriction

intervention: encapsulated rapamycin in feed at 42 ppm (3x standard ITP dose)
canonical_phrase: rapamycin at 42 ppm extended male median lifespan by 23%
notes: Dose-response replication of Harrison 2009 across 4.7 / 14 / 42 ppm. Demonstrated continued benefit at higher dose. BOOTSTRAP SEED — re-validate before cert-blocking.

source_paper.title: Rapamycin-mediated lifespan increase in mice is dose and sex dependent and metabolically distinct from dietary restriction

intervention: encapsulated rapamycin in feed at 42 ppm (3x standard ITP dose)
canonical_phrase: rapamycin at 42 ppm extended female median lifespan by 26%
notes: Append-only companion to miller_2014_dose_response (male 23%). Source paper reported both sexes at the 42 ppm dose; only the male canonical was seeded originally. Closes the 26% canonical gap caught by MiMo audit. Re-validate before cert-blocking.
